boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Farmingdale State College rituals and recurring events, from Ram-Bo’s founding-year jersey to the spring Fountain Fest and RamChella sequence.

cards.title: Read the Year Hidden on Ram-Bo’s Jersey
cards.subtitle: The mascot wears 12 for FSC’s 1912 founding year
cards.notes: When Ram-Bo appears, look for the 12 on his jersey and connect the mascot’s uniform to Farmingdale’s founding year, 1912.
cards.short_summary: A jersey number turns the college’s founding date into a visible campus-spirit ritual.
cards.evidence_claim: Farmingdale State College states that Ram-Bo’s signature number 12 jersey pays tribute to the year FSC was founded and links generations through tradition and team spirit.
cards.access_notes: Ram-Bo appears at campus events and athletics; appearance schedules vary, so consult the event organizer or RamCentral.

cards.title: Welcome Spring at Fountain Fest
cards.subtitle: FSC’s spring celebration at Ralph Bunche Plaza
cards.notes: Watch the spring calendar for Fountain Fest, then head to Bunche Plaza for the campus celebration that precedes the RamChella reveal.
cards.short_summary: Farmingdale marks spring with a plaza gathering built around its own fountain-themed celebration.
cards.evidence_claim: Farmingdale’s visitor page identifies Fountain Fest as a celebration that welcomes spring, and an official 2026 notice says the RamChella lineup reveal occurred there.
cards.access_notes: The date changes annually; check FSC’s official events calendar and Student Activities announcements before visiting.

cards.title: Close the Spring with RamChella
cards.subtitle: FSC’s annual concert-and-carnival finale
cards.notes: Reserve through the announced student process, collect the required wristband, and plan separately for the afternoon carnival and evening concert.
cards.short_summary: A Farmingdale-branded carnival and concert provides the academic year’s large-scale student finale.
cards.evidence_claim: FSC’s 2026 announcement scheduled RamChella for May 7 with an afternoon carnival and evening concert, requiring enrolled students to RSVP and collect wristbands.
cards.access_notes: The 2026 edition required current spring enrollment, an updated FSC ID, advance RSVP, and wristband pickup; future rules may change.

cards.title: Come Home for Farmingdale Fest
cards.subtitle: FSC’s named homecoming weekend
cards.notes: Check the homecoming program before arriving; activities may span multiple days and use different campus locations and RSVP rules.
cards.short_summary: Farmingdale’s homecoming gathers students, alumni, employees, and families under one college-specific festival name.
cards.evidence_claim: The official 2024 Farmingdale Fest page identifies the celebration as FSC’s second annual homecoming weekend and lists a multiday campus program.
cards.access_notes: Programming, eligibility, reservations, and locations vary by activity; use the current homecoming page when a new edition is announced.

cards.title: See FSC’s Cultures Share One Stage
cards.subtitle: An annual student celebration of cultural traditions
cards.notes: Review the year’s program, then attend for the student music, dance, poetry, food, and presentations selected for that edition.
cards.short_summary: Students bring many cultural traditions into one recurring Farmingdale gala rather than a generic campus showcase.
cards.evidence_claim: FSC reported that students gathered for its 11th Annual Multicultural Gala in 2023, featuring music, dancing, poetry, international foods, and remarks.
cards.source_title: Multicultural Gala Celebrates FSC's Many Cultures
cards.access_notes: The cited edition occurred in 2023; confirm the date, admission rules, and venue for any future gala through FSC.

cards.title: Turn a Year’s Work into an IGNITE Poster
cards.subtitle: FSC’s annual applied-learning and research showcase
cards.notes: If eligible, apply to present a poster or Spark Speaker talk; otherwise consult the published program before attending the showcase.
cards.short_summary: Farmingdale’s recurring academic ritual gives student research, creative work, and civic projects a shared public stage.
cards.evidence_claim: FSC describes IGNITE as an annual symposium where students share research, applied-learning, civic-engagement, or creative work through posters and Spark Speaker talks.
cards.access_notes: Presentation is limited to eligible FSC students who apply; consult the current symposium page for attendance and submission details.

cards.title: Gather at the Awareness Bonfire
cards.subtitle: A maintained FSC residence-life signature tradition
cards.notes: Follow Residence Life’s event instructions and remain within the supervised gathering area; do not approach or handle the fire setup.
cards.short_summary: FSC combines an awareness observance with a supervised bonfire recognized in its annual report as a signature tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Farmingdale’s 2024–2025 annual report says Residence Life maintained the Breast Cancer Awareness Bonfire as one of its signature traditions.
cards.source_title: Farmingdale State College Annual Report to SUNY 2024–2025
cards.access_notes: Attend only when officially scheduled and supervised by FSC; consult Residence Life for current eligibility, location, and safety rules.

cards.title: Join the Heritage-Month Block Party
cards.subtitle: An FSC signature tradition on the Campus Center Lawn
cards.notes: Look for the September Student Activities calendar, then use the announced lawn location and rain plan for this cultural gathering.
cards.short_summary: A campus-lawn block party anchors Farmingdale’s recurring Hispanic Heritage Month programming.
cards.evidence_claim: FSC’s 2024–2025 annual report identifies the Hispanic Heritage Month Block Party as a maintained signature tradition, and the fall event calendar places it on the Campus Center Lawn.
cards.source_title: Farmingdale State College Annual Report to SUNY 2024–2025
cards.access_notes: The date and weather plan vary; check the current Student Activities calendar before attending.

cards.title: Pause Finals for Late Night Breakfast
cards.subtitle: FSC’s documented end-of-semester evening meal
cards.notes: Check the finals-week calendar, bring any required student identification, and arrive at the announced dining venue near the start time.
cards.short_summary: Farmingdale turns a late finals-week meal into a recurring residence-life gathering.
cards.evidence_claim: FSC’s annual report calls Late-Night Breakfast a maintained signature tradition, while the fall 2025 student handbook scheduled it for 9 p.m. at POP’s Dining.
cards.source_title: Fall 2025 Student Handbook and Code of Conduct
cards.access_notes: The directly documented Fall 2025 event began at 9 p.m. at POP’s Dining; verify the current semester’s date, venue, and eligibility.

cards.title: Wear FSC Colors on College Color Day
cards.subtitle: A recurring opening-week school-spirit event
cards.notes: Check the opening-week calendar, wear Farmingdale colors if participating, and visit the listed campus table during its posted window.
cards.short_summary: FSC repeatedly assigns a named opening-week event to visible school-color participation.
cards.evidence_claim: The official 2024–2025 Student Activities report lists College Color Day in both the fall 2024 and spring 2025 event calendars.
cards.source_title: Office of Student Activities 2024–2025 Annual Report
cards.access_notes: This event’s location and time change by semester; consult the current opening-week calendar before participating.
